Sources

Standards and sources

Every claim in the academy traces to a source with a version and a review date. This is the register, including what is verified and what still needs rechecking.

Review date 2026-11-25. Verified means read on a date shown. Carried means kept from the research blueprint and rechecked before release.

How we use sources

  • Teach the concept in our own words. Cite identifiers and titles, not protected text.
  • Pin the version and the review date wherever a figure or a date appears.
  • Where sources disagree, say so and follow the primary source.
  • Paid standards are used for ideas only. We link to the authoritative page and do not reproduce the standard.
  • The arc42 template is used under its licence with attribution and a link to the licence.

Reviewed 2026-11-25. Intellica is independent of iSAQB, arc42, ISO, IEC, IEEE and the Software Engineering Institute. Mappings show how our lessons relate to published topics. They are not an affiliation, an approval or a prediction of any exam result.
